working_well: Population age 3+ at school or learning institution: 51.5% in 2019 census, 100th percentile within the peer-group (tier 4) — higher than the peer_group median of 43.5%.
needs_attention: Labour-force participation rate, age 15–64: 68.5% in 2019 census, 9th percentile within the peer-group (tier 4) — lower than the peer_group median of 71.2%.
what_changed: County budget absorption rate improved by 3.1 percentage points as of FY 2024/25 (was 71.9%, now 75%).
Development budget absorption rate improved by 1.8 percentage points as of FY 2024/25 (was 55.2%, now 57%).
